# Infriva Solutions

> Infriva Solutions is a New Delhi-based B2B digital architecture, software engineering, and full-funnel growth studio. We design and engineer high-performance Next.js web platforms, custom PostgreSQL/Supabase CRM systems, full-stack technical SEO & Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), algorithmic Meta & Google Ads systems, and WhatsApp Cloud API retention workflows.

## Core Capabilities & Transparent Pricing

- [Web Dev & UI/UX Design](https://www.infrivasolutions.com/services/web-development): High-performance B2B web platforms built on React 19, Next.js App Router, TypeScript, and PostgreSQL. Investment: ₹80,000+ (One-time), 45 Business Days delivery, 90-day post-launch warranty.
- [Custom CRM Systems](https://www.infrivasolutions.com/services/crm-systems): Bespoke PostgreSQL & Supabase CRM systems with automated lead routing, Row-Level Security (RLS), and WhatsApp/Meta webhook ingestion. Investment: ₹90,000+ (One-time), 60 Business Days delivery, 90-day post-launch warranty.
- [Full-Stack SEO & GEO](https://www.infrivasolutions.com/services/seo-and-geo): Technical SEO, Schema.org entity graphs, and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) for Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT Search, and Perplexity. Investment: ₹65,000 / month.
- [Paid Advertising Management](https://www.infrivasolutions.com/services/paid-advertising): Meta Advantage+ and Google Search/PMax performance engineering with server-side Conversions API (CAPI) and offline CRM attribution. Investment: ₹50,000 / month + 10% Ad Spend.
- [Retention Marketing (WhatsApp API)](https://www.infrivasolutions.com/services/retention-marketing): Official Meta WhatsApp Cloud API lifecycle automation, abandoned cart recovery, and win-back sequences. Investment: ₹25,000 / month.
- [Premium Content Creation](https://www.infrivasolutions.com/services/premium-content): Executive B2B thought leadership, long-form technical articles, and short-form video distribution. Investment: ₹60,000 / month.
- [Social Media Management](https://www.infrivasolutions.com/services/social-media-management): Human-curated static posts, 3 reels/week, and 1 long-form video/month across Instagram, LinkedIn, and YouTube. Investment: ₹20,000 / month.

## Verified Client Case Studies

- [FlyingLyte — Travel & Flight Booking Engine](https://www.infrivasolutions.com/projects/flyinglyte): Rebuilt a legacy travel portal on Next.js with a custom multi-step booking engine, PostgreSQL CRM, and 12 automated WhatsApp API flows. Outcomes: +40% increase in qualified leads, −55% funnel drop-off reduction, 1.1s LCP.
- [StarX Hotel — Direct Hospitality Booking & Guest CRM](https://www.infrivasolutions.com/projects/starx): Engineered a commission-free direct reservation platform, live inventory CRM, and automated WhatsApp guest concierge for a boutique hotel brand. Outcomes: +35% direct booking share, ~18% OTA commission saved, +22% repeat guest rate.
- [The Kesari Bagh — Luxury Estate Engineering Prototype](https://www.infrivasolutions.com/projects/the-kesari-bagh): High-fidelity French-colonial countryside estate direct-reservation prototype engineered on Next.js 16 and Cloudflare Workers edge runtime with 4-key suite availability locks and automated WhatsApp concierge. Outcomes: 100% direct booking capture prototype, 1.1s mobile LCP, < 15s concierge SLA, ~20% OTA commission saved.
